mentions.name: Total rewrite of long-shipping app
mentions.description: A total rewrite of an app that has been shipping for the last couple of years with moderate success. The rewritten version provides a baseline for adding more capability while maintaining quality, and current work includes revisiting old dependencies with an LLM to improve corner-case handling and documentation.
mentions.source_excerpt: I recently released a total rewrite of an app that's been shipping for the last couple of years, with moderate success.
mentions.author: ChrisMarshallNY
